title: Secret space program friend's father's 'simulacrum' joke
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Secret space program friend's father's 'simulacrum' joke, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in encounters Diana also interviews a friend who's was allegedly part of one of the secret American space programs something like the one Tyler from American Cosmic was in

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a writer named Diana Pasulka, in her book Encounters, interviews a friend who was allegedly part of one of the secret American space programmes. Michels compares this person to Tyler, a man in her earlier book American Cosmic who was said to be in a similar programme. If true, it would mean the United States runs hidden space efforts beyond the ones the public knows about.
